items.caption: Dieterich Buxtehude, Op. I, Violino partbook, Sonata IV, sixth staff, first printed bar, corresponding to combined-score m. 105; Uppsala partbooks through the STIMU facsimile (Utrecht, 1991; introduction by Kerala J. Snyder), supplied library scan-0013, right-hand page.
items.purpose: Document the key signature (B-flat and E-flat, the E-flat doubled at the octave), the natural before the third note, an E5, and the ninth note, an E5 with no sign, which the signature makes E-flat5 because this print signs each note separately, supporting the source-supported emendation of DdT 1903, printed p. 39, m. 105, where the natural on the E5 at beat 1.67 carries to the unsigned E5 at beat 3.67 (E-natural5). The attestation is the signature together with an unsigned note, not a written flat.
